question: The base recipe is now at its knee: 9 epochs, about 8.34 s, accuracy 0.7552-0.7560. Label smoothing turned out not to matter (E004 refutes H1.3.1). Systems tuning has a ceiling, so the next big drop in time has to come from needing fewer epochs. The most decision-relevant open branch is H1.2/H1.2.1, at confidence 0.4-0.5. Does an orthogonalized-momentum optimizer (Muon, or relatives such as Shampoo/SOAP/PSGD with Newton-Schulz orthogonalization) on the conv filters of a small ResNet/airbench-style CNN cut the epochs needed to reach a fixed accuracy, compared with tuned Nesterov SGD? Does that hold in a very short (<10 epoch) CIFAR regime, ideally CIFAR-100? If so, what settings are reported: lr, momentum, Newton-Schulz steps, batch size, which parameters go to Muon versus SGD, and schedule? And does the per-step overhead of orthogonalization eat into the wall-clock gain?

rubric: Compares an orthogonalized or matrix-preconditioned optimizer (Muon, Shampoo, SOAP, PSGD, spectral-norm descent) against tuned SGD or Adam on convolutional networks, with results on CIFAR-10/100 or similar small-image data
Reports epochs or steps to reach a target accuracy, or wall-clock time to reach it, not only final accuracy after long training

Gives concrete settings that can be reproduced: lr, momentum, batch size, Newton-Schulz iterations or preconditioner update frequency, and how 4D conv kernels are reshaped or which parameters are excluded
Covers short training budgets (under about 20 epochs) or measures the optimizer's per-step compute overhead
exclude: Methods that rely on pretrained weights, transfer learning, distillation from a pretrained teacher, or external/extra data
Test-time augmentation or anything that uses the test set (forbidden by RULES.md)
Work evaluated only on LLM/transformer language-model pretraining with no CNN or vision results
Large-scale ImageNet-only studies with multi-GPU budgets and no small-image or short-budget evidence
Methods needing packages outside PyTorch 2.4.0 / torchvision 0.19.0 that cannot be reimplemented in a few hundred lines
